note: _gens sancta –_ holy nation; heiliges Volk. Walter Thiele: _Die lateinischen Texte des 1. Petrusbriefes_. Freiburg 1965 (245 pp.), pp. 185–189.

_sed etiam dyscolis_ – (be not only submissive to the gentle masters) but also to the froward (Douay Version). – J.M. Harden (_Dictionary of the Vulgate New Testament_. London. 1921 [xi, 125 pp.], p. 37) and Richards (p. 40) translate _dyscolus/discolus_ as “peevish, irritable.” See above, s.v. in the glossary (Chapter 19.2).
